County Wexford Chamber Skillnet is promoted by County Wexford Chamber of Commerce. Membership of the network is open to private enterprises in the Southeast region. Training is mainly delivered in County Wexford. 1.2 Funding Model County Wexford Chamber Skillnet is co-funded by Skillnet Ireland and member companies. Skillnet Ireland receives funding from the National Training Fund through the Department of Further and Higher Education, Research, Innovation and Science, with additional support from the European Union. Background to the Training Requirements for County Wexford Chamber Skillnet County Wexford Chamber Skillnet operates in line with the protocols and requirements of Skillnet Ireland. The purpose of this RFT is to create a panel of qualified trainers. From this panel, trainers will be invited to participate in mini competitions for the design and delivery of training programmes, as specified in the Requirements.
